scope: Batch 09H/09H, completing 40 profiles with 120 independently written source-linked fight decisions. No independent gameplay tests.

decisions.title: Build Exhaustion through safe Light-to-Heavy choices
decisions.text: Luke Cage can develop Exhaustion through eligible combo and Heavy patterns, supporting later control. Check the opponent's debuff immunity and make a Heavy only after creating a reliable punish window.

decisions.title: Use SP2 Concussion only when enough Exhaustion is present
decisions.text: An SP2 can convert a developed Exhaustion setup into Concussion pressure. If the target resists ability-accuracy reduction or cleanses debuffs, do not assume this disables every defensive effect.

decisions.title: Choose SP1 Stun or SP3 Trauma for a specific encounter
decisions.text: SP1 can support a Stun opportunity while the other required effect is active, whereas SP3 may reward a longer damage plan. Confirm the Stun before extending your combo, and compare the expensive setup with the fight's remaining duration.

decisions.title: Enter a Heavy-charge Evade window only when available
decisions.text: Lumatrix can use a charged Heavy with the relevant Evade resource to develop Cunning and Invisibility. Check cooldown and opponent anti-Evade tools before treating a charged Heavy as a universal safe intercept.

decisions.title: Keep Invisibility going with SP1 when resources permit
decisions.text: SP1 can help maintain the Invisibility plan, with additional Cunning value depending on retained power. Count the current resources instead of assuming every SP1 refresh gives the maximum offensive benefit.

decisions.title: Save SP2 Fury for a developed Cunning bank
decisions.text: A high Cunning count can support stronger SP2 damage while SP3 may offer a longer protected Invisibility state. Check the opponent's anti-Miss mechanic and your available power to decide whether the slow setup is viable.

decisions.title: Finish a Heavy and roar only from a safe opening
decisions.text: M'Baku's Heavy-related Fury setup includes an animation that can leave him vulnerable when rushed. First create a recovery opportunity and verify the buff is active before planning the next attack.

decisions.title: Use the dash-range condition to trigger Unstoppable
decisions.text: Running in from outside striking range can activate a specific Unstoppable opportunity. Slow and other anti-Unstoppable effects can disrupt it, so check the actual buff instead of expecting any forward dash to protect you.

decisions.title: Spend SP2 after Unstoppable damage has developed
decisions.text: SP2 can cash accumulated damage from his Unstoppable pressure, with a combo-related resource cost. Check how much offensive value is banked and whether you can rebuild afterward, rather than launching it immediately on two bars.

decisions.title: Build Neutronium before spending an ISO-8 Special
decisions.text: Maestro can gain Neutronium through eligible second-Medium endings and Specials. Watch the counter and relevant ISO-8 effects before expecting SP2 to provide the fully prepared Fury payoff.

decisions.title: Choose SP2 when the right ISO-8 state is active
decisions.text: SP2 can reward an available ISO-8 condition with Fury, but an opponent or node that removes buffs may interrupt the next step. Check the state and power before committing to a longer damage cycle.

decisions.title: Use SP1 during Superior Rage without shortening the window
decisions.text: During Superior Rage, SP1 can benefit from developed Fury and energy-damage pressure. Avoid unnecessary knockdowns that end the useful state early; choose a Special punish that fits the remaining timer.

decisions.title: Select pre-fight debuffs for the actual path threat
decisions.text: Mister Fantastic can bring pre-fight choices targeting healing, power behavior or damage-over-time. Select the debuff that addresses the next defenders instead of activating every option without regard to availability or stacking rules.

decisions.title: Refresh the selected debuffs only from controlled openings
decisions.text: Heavy attacks and Specials can support the uptime of prepared effects, but a long Heavy charge is unsafe if the defender can immediately counterattack. Check the debuff timer and opponent power before attempting a refresh.

decisions.title: Build Careful Study only when Special baiting is practical
decisions.text: SP1 can encourage an opponent's repeated Specials, supporting Careful Study, while SP3 offers a different debuff-dependent Fury plan. Avoid baiting an especially dangerous Special purely to accelerate the setup.
